hero.credit: This digital media file - and/or the physical objects depicted on it - originates from the digital and/or physical collections of the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, national library of the Netherlands.
hero.description: The map shows a section across South-America between Rio de Janeiro and Buenos Aires and was engraved by Gerard Coeck (1608/1609-c. 1649) and ordered by Joan Blaeu (1598-1673). Blaeu probable had to wait more than ten years for its publication. The map can only be found in the Atlas Maior.
